title: A Nursing Home’s First Day Out of Lockdown: An Update

sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报栏目 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会上，现场采访商业、政治和文化领域一些极具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.
万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多嘉宾。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11 月 18 日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上对部分访谈进行现场直播，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》App 进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
This week, The Daily is revisiting some of our favorite episodes of the year and hearing what's happened in the time since they first ran.
sentences.zh: 本周，《The Daily》将重温今年我们最喜欢的一些单集，并了解它们首次播出后所发生的变化。

sentences.en: You've got a good group here.
sentences.zh: 你们这里有一群很好的人。

sentences.en: Oh, because I was to your birthday party when you was ninety-five.
sentences.zh: 哦，因为你九十五岁生日的时候我去过。

sentences.en: Today, we return to the Good Shepherd Nursing Home, which allowed us inside, just as it was
sentences.zh: 今天，我们重返善牧疗养院。今年二月，正值该疗养院从长达一年的封锁中解封之际，

sentences.en: emerging from a year-long lockdown in February, to see how life has changed for its residents.
sentences.zh: 他们允许我们进去，看看居民们的生活发生了怎样的变化。
今天是 12 月 30 日，星期四。
请问，你是……休塞克女士吗？

sentences.en: Earlier this year, in February, I met a woman named Zeta Husek, who lives at the Good Shepherd
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，也就是二月，我遇到了一位名叫齐塔·休塞克的老人，她住在西弗吉尼亚州惠灵的

sentences.en: Nursing Home in Wheeling, West Virginia.
I'm going to be ninety-six next month.
sentences.zh: 我下个月就九十六岁了。

sentences.en: I talked to Zeta over FaceTime.
sentences.zh: 我通过 FaceTime 和齐塔进行了交谈。

sentences.en: There was some medical equipment beeping in the background.
sentences.zh: 背景里有某种医疗设备的蜂鸣声。

sentences.en: They always tell me I look younger because I act young, and I don't dress like an old lady.
sentences.zh: 他们总是说我看起来更年轻，因为我行为举止年轻，而且我不穿老太太的衣服。

sentences.en: So, and I was married for fifty-three years.
sentences.zh: 所以，我结婚了五十三年。

sentences.en: I waited till I was thirty because I was having a good time, and I didn't want to settle down.
sentences.zh: 我三十岁才结婚，因为我那时过得很开心，不想安定下来。

sentences.en: I didn't have no time for that.
So, tell me about what life has been like during the virus, during COVID.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我聊聊在病毒期间、在疫情期间生活是什么样的。

sentences.en: What has, what has your life been like?
sentences.zh: 你的生活……曾经是怎样的？

sentences.en: We were stuck in our room, and we've been just sitting in our rooMs.
sentences.zh: 我们被困在房间里，一直坐在房间里。

sentences.en: We used to go out in the hall, but then they quit.
sentences.zh: 我们以前可以去走廊，但后来他们不让了。

sentences.en: We wasn't allowed because they didn't want us to be close to one another.
sentences.zh: 我们不被允许出去，因为他们不想让我们靠得太近。

sentences.en: Were you eating your meals, and where were you eating your...
sentences.zh: 你吃饭了吗？你是在哪里吃……

sentences.en: It was boring because all I did was sleep and watch TV.
sentences.zh: 太无聊了，因为我除了睡觉就是看电视。

sentences.en: Whatever was on, I liked to watch the shooting, the wedding gowns, all these older women getting married in white, I was surprised.
sentences.zh: 播什么看什么，我喜欢看枪战、婚纱，所有这些老太太穿着白纱结婚的画面，我很惊讶。

sentences.en: Well, in my time, you wasn't allowed to get married in white unless you were supposed to be a virgin.
sentences.zh: 嗯，在我那个年代，你是不准穿白纱结婚的，除非你本该是个处女。

sentences.en: I don't know what to tell you.
They even had children there, and they're still just in white.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至还有孩子在那儿，而且他们也穿着白色的衣服。

sentences.en: I also met Betty Lou Leach.
sentences.zh: 我还遇到了贝蒂·露·里奇。

sentences.en: Born in 24, so you figure it out.
What has been the hardest part of the last year for you?
sentences.zh: 对你来说，过去一年中最艰难的部分是什么？

sentences.en: What's been the hardest part of this whole last year?
sentences.zh: 过去整整一年中最艰难的部分是什么？

sentences.en: I think the hardest part is missing your family.
sentences.zh: 我觉得最艰难的部分是思念家人。

sentences.en: I, uh, my sister was here, and she passed away.
sentences.zh: 我，呃，我姐姐曾在这里，她去世了。

sentences.en: That was the hardest time I had, and it's been, I don't know, quite an adjustment.
sentences.zh: 那是我经历过最艰难的时期，而且，我不知道，这需要相当长的时间来适应。

sentences.en: She passed away at the very beginning of this pandemic, didn't she?
sentences.zh: 她是在这场大流行刚开始时去世的，对吗？

sentences.en: Yes, she didn't go to the funeral.
sentences.zh: 是的，我没能去参加葬礼。

sentences.en: And you weren't able to go to the funeral.
sentences.zh: 而且你没能去参加葬礼。

sentences.en: No, I wasn't able to go to the funeral.
sentences.zh: 是的，我没能去参加葬礼。

sentences.en: Her sister didn't die of COVID, but because of COVID, she couldn't grieve with her family, or even see much of them.
sentences.zh: 她的姐姐并不是死于新冠，但由于新冠，她无法与家人一起悲伤，甚至无法经常见到他们。

sentences.en: And I do miss my daughter so very, very much.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想念我的女儿，非常非常想。

sentences.en: You don't know what it is, how happy it is, and how joyful you are when you do see them.
sentences.zh: 你不会明白，当你真正见到他们时，那是多么幸福、多么快乐。

sentences.en: But we talk, oh, maybe two or three times a day, and we always talk every night.
sentences.zh: 但我们通电话，哦，一天大概两三次，我们每天晚上都会通话。

sentences.en: We say goodnight to each other every night.
sentences.zh: 我们每天晚上都互道晚安。

sentences.en: And she calls in the mornings, and then we're okay.
sentences.zh: 她早上会打电话来，然后我们就都好好的。

sentences.en: What are you looking forward to most when things change, and you're able to get back to some normalcy next week with activities?
sentences.zh: 当情况发生变化，下周你能够恢复某种带有活动的正常生活时，你最期待的是什么？

sentences.en: Well, for one thing, I'm looking for the dining room to open.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一方面，我期待着餐厅重新开放。

sentences.en: They always had it decorated beautiful.
sentences.zh: 他们总是把那里装饰得很漂亮。

sentences.en: The girls down here took care of you.
sentences.zh: 这里的姑娘们把你们照顾得很好。

sentences.en: And you get to see people.
And that's important, to see people.
And, uh, I really miss the dining room.
sentences.zh: 而且，呃，我真的很怀念餐厅。

sentences.en: I'll be the first one here.
sentences.zh: 我会是第一个到那儿的人。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, and I will, uh, hopefully see you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，我，呃，希望周一能见到你。

sentences.en: A few days after I talk to Zuta and Betty Lou, I get in my car and head to West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 跟齐塔和贝蒂·露交谈几天后，我上了车，朝西弗吉尼亚州驶去。

sentences.en: So, it's a little before 9 a.m.
sentences.zh: 现在是星期一早上快9点的时候，

sentences.en: on Monday morning, and I'm here at Good Shepherd Nursing Home.
And we are about to go inside and hopefully talk to some residents and staffers as they begin to open up for the first time amid the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我们马上要进去，希望能跟一些居民和工作人员聊聊，因为他们在大流行期间首次开始解封。

sentences.en: So, we'll be probably among the only people in there who are not working there.
sentences.zh: 所以我们很可能是里面仅有的几个不在那里工作的人。

sentences.en: When I get to Good Shepherd...
sentences.zh: 当我到达善牧疗养院时……

sentences.en: I get a rapid COVID teSt.
sentences.zh: 我做了一个新冠快速检测。

sentences.en: I'm wearing an N95 mask, and they give me PPE.
sentences.zh: 我戴着 N95 口罩，他们给了我个人防护装备。

sentences.en: I have goggles and gloves, and that wrestling here is my gown, PPE.
sentences.zh: 我有护目镜和手套，这里挂着的防护服是我的长袍，也就是个人防护装备。

sentences.en: And they ask me to wear a medical gown over my clothes.
sentences.zh: 他们让我套上一件医疗防护服穿在衣服外面。

sentences.en: This is the first day in nearly a year that the nursing home is having group activities again.
sentences.zh: 这是近一年来这家疗养院第一次恢复集体活动。

sentences.en: I had planned to start my day in the chapel, where they were having mass.
sentences.zh: 我原本计划从教堂开始我的一天，他们正在那里做弥撒。

sentences.en: But then, while mass was going on, I heard this commotion happening outside in the hall.
sentences.zh: 但就在做弥撒的时候，我听到走廊外面传来了骚动。

sentences.en: So, I sneak outside to see what's happening.
sentences.zh: 于是，我悄悄溜出去看看发生了什么。

sentences.en: I'm Sarah from the New York Times.
Yes, I talked to you on FaceTime.
I see that you're sitting right in front of the...
sentences.zh: 我看到你正坐在……的前面

sentences.en: Oh, it's the most exciting day to be in there.
sentences.zh: 哦，能在里面待着真是最让人激动的一天。

sentences.en: And in the hallway, I find Betty Lou, who is right outside the dining room.
sentences.zh: 在走廊里，我遇到了贝蒂·路易，她就在餐厅外面。

sentences.en: She's dressed up, her hair is curled, and she's wearing a bracelet her daughter had given her.
sentences.zh: 她盛装打扮，头发烫了卷，还戴着女儿送给她的手链。

sentences.en: And you look really nice today.
She's ready to be the first one inside the dining room doors for lunch.
sentences.zh: 她已经准备好成为第一个走进餐厅吃午饭的人了。

sentences.en: Yes, I should have brought my camera down.
sentences.zh: 对，我本该把相机拿下来的。

sentences.en: We head into the dining room.
This is a pretty favorite spot.
sentences.zh: 这是个很受欢迎的地方。

sentences.en: And one by one, people start trickling in.
sentences.zh: 人们开始三三两两地走进来。

sentences.en: Hey, you're sitting at my table today.
Sherry, what would you like to do?
The residents are chatting amongst themselves.
sentences.zh: 居民们正在三三两两地聊天。

sentences.en: Hey, you look pretty good today.

sentences.zh: 我们真的太想念这个了。

sentences.en: And I'm walking around the dining room getting to know people.
sentences.zh: 我在餐厅里走来走去，跟大家打招呼。

sentences.en: You get dressed up to come to the dining room.
sentences.zh: 来餐厅是要精心打扮的。

sentences.en: Because this is the first time we've been down here for like six or eight months.
sentences.zh: 因为这是我们六八个月来第一次下楼。

sentences.en: We have not been out of our rooMs.
Even though most of the residents and staff have been vaccinated, the nursing home is still social distancing.
sentences.zh: 尽管大多数居民和员工都已经接种了疫苗，但疗养院仍在保持社交距离。

sentences.en: There are two people at a table instead of the usual four.
sentences.zh: 一张桌子坐两个人，而不是通常的四个人。

sentences.en: Still, there's a moment when I see two friends who can't help but reach across the table and grasp each other's hands.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，我还是看到两个朋友忍不住隔着桌子去握对方的手。

sentences.en: As I'm watching this scene unfold, what stands out to me is the simplicity of it all.
sentences.zh: 看着这一幕，最打动我的是它的纯粹与简单。

sentences.en: It isn't some big emotional reunion.
sentences.zh: 这并不是什么轰轰烈烈的情感重聚。

sentences.en: But it's something as simple as saying, how are you, to a friend.
sentences.zh: 而只是一句简单的“你好吗”，对朋友的问候。

sentences.en: Or being able to ask, how do you like the soup?
sentences.zh: 或者是问一句“你觉得这汤怎么样？”

sentences.en: These small, ordinary moments of connection that so few of us have had this year.
sentences.zh: 这些微小而平凡的连结瞬间，今年我们当中很少有人能体验到。

sentences.en: We're all bouncing back here, buddy.
sentences.zh: 我们都在这里振作起来了，伙计。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，还不需要输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订户每天都能获取什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，免费畅读30天。

sentences.en: At about 2 o'clock, everyone begins to gather for what had been one of the most popular activities before the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 大约两点钟，大家开始聚集在一起，参加疫情前最受欢迎的活动之一。

sentences.en: All of the residents get pennies, which they can use to bid.
sentences.zh: 所有的居民都会分到一分钱硬币，他们可以用这些硬币来竞拍。

sentences.en: And there's a big table at the front of the room where a bunch of auction items are set up.
sentences.zh: 房间正前方有一张大桌子，上面摆满了各种拍卖品。

sentences.en: There are cookies and quilts and a stuffed Snoopy.
sentences.zh: 有饼干、被子和一个史努比毛绒玩具。

sentences.en: And all around, residents are spread out in a maze of socially distanced wheelchairs.
sentences.zh: 四周错落有致地摆放着轮椅，居民们保持着社交距离坐在里面。

sentences.en: I'm Sarah from The New York Times.
The first item up is a handbag with a few things in it.
sentences.zh: 第一个拍卖品是一个装了几样东西的手提包。

sentences.en: A body spray, a toothbrush, a toothpaste, a lady's deodorant.
sentences.zh: 一瓶身体喷雾、一把牙刷、一支牙膏、一瓶女士止汗剂。

sentences.en: Then there's a light-up St. Patrick's Day necklace.
sentences.zh: 接着是一条会发光的圣帕特里克节项链。

sentences.en: A giant tub of cheese puffs.
And Betty Lou, who's been awfully quiet so far, decides to go all in.
sentences.zh: 一直以来相当安静的贝蒂·路易，决定孤注一掷。

sentences.en: And ends up taking home the prize.

sentences.zh: 我谁也不会原谅的，埃迪。

sentences.en: So, Betty, you spent all your pennies on cheese puffs.
sentences.zh: 所以，贝蒂，你把你所有的硬币都花在起司泡芙上了。

sentences.en: Are you happy with your purchase?
sentences.zh: 你对你的战利品满意吗？

sentences.en: Thank you all for coming down for the auction today.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家今天来参加拍卖会。

sentences.en: We're so lucky you guys can do this today.
sentences.zh: 我们真幸运，大家今天能聚在一起。

sentences.en: And as the day goes on, I realize there's one person I still need to talk to.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，我意识到还有一个我必须去谈谈的人。

sentences.en: And that's Don Kirsch, the administrator of the nursing home.
sentences.zh: 那就是疗养院的行政主管唐·柯尔施。

sentences.en: He's the one who gave the orders to shut down last year.
sentences.zh: 就是他去年下令封锁的。

sentences.en: And he's also the one who ultimately gave the okay to come out of lockdown.
sentences.zh: 也是他最终批准了解除封锁。

sentences.en: Okay, I see you wrote this down.
sentences.zh: 好的，我看到你把这个写下来了。

sentences.en: And as we sit down, he pulls out a statement that he's typed up on a piece of paper.
sentences.zh: 当我们坐下时，他拿出一份打印在纸上的声明。

sentences.en: Do you want to just maybe read this for the audio in your own voice?
sentences.zh: 你要不要用你自己的声音把这段录音读一下？

sentences.en: Or read, you know, parts of it?
sentences.zh: 或者读，你知道的，其中的一部分？

sentences.en: Tragically, we experienced a corona, coronavirus outbreak in November of 2020, infecting 20 residents, resulting in five resident deaths.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我们在2020年11月经历了一场新冠病毒疫情，导致20名居民感染，5名居民死亡。

sentences.en: Yes, we are brokenhearted by this loss of life.
sentences.zh: 是的，对于生命的消逝，我们感到心碎。

sentences.en: These individuals and their loved ones are in our thoughts and prayers each day.
sentences.zh: 这些逝者和他们的亲人每天都在我们的思念和祈祷中。

sentences.en: This is a really, it's been an emotional time this past year.
sentences.zh: 这真的是，过去这一年真是充满情绪的一年。

sentences.en: And so, tell me why, you know, when you were talking about what you've been through, you got a little choked up.
sentences.zh: 那么，告诉我为什么，当你谈到你的经历时，你有点哽咽了。

sentences.en: Well, Sarah, it's been the greatest challenge of our careers.
sentences.zh: 嗯，莎拉，这是我们职业生涯中最大的挑战。

sentences.en: And I'm not only speaking for myself, but for all of our staff.
sentences.zh: 我不仅代表我自己，也代表我们所有的员工。

sentences.en: Wheeling is such a tight knit community.
sentences.zh: 惠灵是一个非常紧密的社区。

sentences.en: A lot of us have grown up together.
sentences.zh: 我们很多人都是一起长大的。

sentences.en: And we had the pleasure of taking care of individuals in the time in their lives, other than childhood, possibly when they needed others the moSt.
sentences.zh: 在人们除了童年之外、可能最需要他人照顾的人生阶段，我们有幸能够照顾他们。

sentences.en: And how long have you been the administrator here at Good Shepherd?
sentences.zh: 你在好牧者养老院担任管理者多久了？

sentences.en: And in those 40 years, have you ever experienced anything like this?
sentences.zh: 在这40年里，你经历过类似这样的情况吗？

sentences.en: No, as I said, this has been the greatest challenge of a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 没有，就像我说的，这是我一生中遇到过最大的挑战。

sentences.en: Are there days that stand out to you during the pandemic as being pivotal?
sentences.zh: 在疫情期间，有没有哪几天对你来说至关重要？

sentences.en: Two days stood out when we began to see what was happening throughout the state of West Virginia.
sentences.zh: 当我们开始看到西弗吉尼亚州各地的情况时，有两天格外突出。

sentences.en: I had made the decision on March 11th to close the facility to outside visitors.
sentences.zh: 我在3月11日做出决定，对外部访客关闭养老院。

sentences.en: The other day that stands out to us was December 23rd of last year, when our residents received the first dose of the Moderna vaccine.
sentences.zh: 另一天让我们印象深刻的是去年12月23日，当时我们的居民接种了第一剂莫德纳疫苗。

sentences.en: I felt for the first time in all of those months that we might have the chance of having the upper hand against this virus
sentences.zh: 几个月来，我第一次觉得我们或许有机会在这场病毒面前占居上风

sentences.en: and that we might be able to begin to see the light at the end of the tunnel.
sentences.zh: 并且我们或许能够开始看到隧道尽头的曙光。

sentences.en: You know, I feel a tremendous sense of responsibility for these individuals and a tremendous sense of accountability to them and to their family members.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我对这些人有一种巨大的责任感，对他们以及他们的家人有一种巨大的问责感。

sentences.en: So there's been a tremendous number of sleepless nights,
sentences.zh: 所以有无数个不眠之夜，

sentences.en: a tremendous amount of praying to God for an answer.
sentences.zh: 有无数次向上帝祈祷以寻求答案。

sentences.en: And I hope we're at that point right now.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们现在就处于那个时刻。

sentences.en: I will be so much more happy, Sarah, when their family members are able to come in and see their loved ones again.
sentences.zh: 萨拉，当他们的家人能够进来再次看望他们的挚爱时，我会高兴得多。

sentences.en: There's no substitute for a one-on-one visit and that love and affection that cannot come through an electronic device.
sentences.zh: 面对面的探访是无可替代的，那种通过电子设备无法传递的爱与温情是无法取代的。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much for your time, Mr. Krish.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢你抽出时间，克里什先生。

sentences.en: Well, we'll be here for Bunko later.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们待会儿会留在这里玩朋克牌游戏。

sentences.en: Did anyone, did your parents explain Bunko to you?
sentences.zh: 有人——你的父母向你解释过朋克牌游戏吗？

sentences.en: You know, I think Zeta explained Bunko.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想齐塔解释过朋克牌游戏。
是啊，她挺有一套的，不是吗？

sentences.en: She said something about dice and getting to 23.
sentences.zh: 她说了些关于骰子和凑到23点的事。

sentences.en: Maybe I'll have to have her explain it again tonight.
sentences.zh: 也许我今晚得让她再解释一遍。

sentences.en: Around 7 o'clock, I head to the final event of the day, a dice game called Bunko.
sentences.zh: 大约7点钟，我前往当天最后活动的现场，一个叫做朋克牌的掷骰子游戏。

sentences.en: Betty Lou and Zeta are there, along with three others.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂·卢和齐塔在那里，还有其他三个人。

sentences.en: They're sitting around a table, and they each have a small cup of cheese puffs in front of them.
sentences.zh: 她们围坐在桌旁，每个人面前都有一个小杯子的起司泡芙。

sentences.en: Betty Lou had brought her auction winnings to share.
sentences.zh: 贝蒂·卢带来了她拍卖赢来的奖品与大家分享。

sentences.en: As the day draws to a close, I think about what this time at Good Shepherd tells us about the return to normalcy after the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 随着这一天接近尾声，我回想着在好牧者养老院的这段经历向我们揭示了关于疫情后重返正常生活的什么启示。

sentences.en: There may have been an off switch at the beginning, but I realize there will be no on switch, no one instant when everything goes back to normal.
sentences.zh: 一开始可能有一个关闭按钮，但我意识到不会有什么开启按钮，不会有某个瞬间让一切瞬间恢复正常。

sentences.en: But more and more, we may find moments of healing and togetherness.
sentences.zh: 但我们会越来越多地发现疗愈与陪伴的时刻。
和朋友一起玩骰子游戏。

sentences.en: Hey girls, it was really nice playing.
Betty Lou, what did you think?
Lunch and penny auction and Bunko.
sentences.zh: 午餐、一分钱拍卖会还有朋克牌游戏。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh, it's been a busy day.
sentences.zh: 哦天哪，真是忙碌的一天。

sentences.en: How do you feel at the end of the day?
sentences.zh: 这一天结束时你感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: I feel very happy about today.
sentences.zh: 我对今天感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: Do you think you'll ever come back this way?
sentences.zh: 你觉得你还会再来这边吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I think probably one day.
Good night to see you tomorrow.
Oh, thanks for listening to me.
I loved getting to know you, and I'm so glad you got to play Bunko.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能了解你，我很高兴你能玩朋克牌游戏。

sentences.en: After the break, daily producer Stella Tan gets an update from Good Shepherd.
sentences.zh: 休息过后，日常制作人斯特拉·陈带来了好牧者养老院的最新情况。

sentences.en: Sarah just had a baby, and she's out on leave.
sentences.zh: 萨拉刚生了孩子，目前正在休假。

sentences.en: So, a few weeks ago, I got in touch with Good Shepherd to see what's been going on since she visited.
sentences.zh: 所以几周前，我联系了好牧者养老院，想了解她上次访问以来那里发生了什么。

sentences.en: I found out that after that initial period of starting to open up in February, they'd actually had to cycle in and out of lockdowns periodically throughout the year.
sentences.zh: 我发现，在二月份开始逐渐开放的最初阶段之后，他们实际上在这一年中不得不周期性地进出封锁状态。

sentences.en: And in light of that, I really wanted to check in on how Betty Lou was doing.
sentences.zh: 鉴于此，我非常想了解贝蒂·卢的情况。
于是，我给她打了个电话。

sentences.en: It's a real pleasure to meet you.
Okay, I'll get closer to the microphone.
Is it okay if I ask you some questions about what life has been like at Good Shepherd since
sentences.zh: 我可以问你一些关于自从二月份以来好牧者养老院的生活

sentences.en: Yeah, you can ask me some questions.
sentences.zh: 可以，你可以问我一些问题。

sentences.en: Well, let's start with just today.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们从今天开始聊起。

sentences.en: This is a good day, a happy day.
sentences.zh: 这是美好的一天，开心的一天。

sentences.en: My daughter just came in to visit me because they're letting our family come in our room to see us before we had to meet them downstairs for an hour.
sentences.zh: 我女儿刚来看我，因为他们现在允许我们的家人进到房间来看我们了，以前我们必须去楼下见他们一个小时。

sentences.en: But now it's all open and they're coming up and seeing us.
sentences.zh: 但现在完全开放了，他们可以上楼来看我们了。

sentences.en: Happy because you're so happy to be able to say hello in your own room to them.
sentences.zh: 开心是因为你能在自己的房间里跟他们打招呼，感到无比高兴。

sentences.en: It's sad to think that we went through so much.
sentences.zh: 一想到我们经历了那么多，就觉得难过。

sentences.en: Our daughters and family, they encouraged us and called us.
sentences.zh: 我们的女儿和家人，他们鼓励我们，给我们打电话。

sentences.en: And it's all excitement and emotions.
sentences.zh: 全都是激动和各种情绪。

sentences.en: And I don't mean sad, sad.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是那种悲伤的难过。

sentences.en: Oh, you'll know that I'm her daughter because everybody says, I know who you are because you look just like Betty Lou.
sentences.zh: 哦，你知道我是她女儿，因为每个人都说：“我知道你是谁，因为你长得跟贝蒂·卢一模一样。”

sentences.en: Yeah, listen, the first time I've got to see her in her room.
sentences.zh: 对，听着，这是我第一次能在她的房间里见到她。

sentences.en: It's definitely hard to express how happy it makes you.
sentences.zh: 这绝对很难表达它带给你多少快乐。
今天一切都在向好的方向发展。

sentences.en: We're just looking up for it.
Betty Lou, did you ever finish that big tub of cheese puffs that you won at the penny auction in February?
sentences.zh: 贝蒂·卢，你在二月份一分钱拍卖会上赢的那大桶起司泡芙，你吃完了吗？

sentences.en: Well, I won't take up any more of your time.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我不再占用你的时间了。

sentences.en: I know your daughter is there and I'm sure you want the time together.
sentences.zh: 我知道你女儿在那儿，我确信你们想好好聚聚。

sentences.en: I thank you so much for talking because it's nice to know that people out there do care for you besides people here.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你跟我聊天，因为很高兴知道除了这里的人之外，外面的人也在关心你。

sentences.en: I also talked to Don to see how he was feeling as a nursing home administrator, given all the changes in the pandemic since the beginning of the year.
sentences.zh: 我还和唐交谈过，了解他作为一家养老院管理人员的感受，考虑到自今年年初以来大流行期间发生的种种变化。

sentences.en: I wanted to get your thoughts as the administrator.
sentences.zh: 我想听听你作为管理者的想法。

sentences.en: I just want to say at the onset that somewhat surprisingly of the two years that we have been dealing with this pandemic, that this year has been more difficult than laSt.
sentences.zh: 我首先想说的是，在我们应对这场大流行病的两年时间里，有些出人意料的是，这一年比去年更加困难。

sentences.en: And the reason it was more difficult was when the variants started coming along, particularly the Delta variant.
sentences.zh: 之所以更困难，是因为变异株开始出现，尤其是德尔塔变异株。

sentences.en: We had a high level of anxiety as to whether or not the vaccines that our residents and staff received would work against any variants that might come along.
sentences.zh: 我们感到高度焦虑，担心我们的居民和员工接种的疫苗是否能对抗任何可能出现的变异株。

sentences.en: So in the back of our minds, we were always questioning ourselves, what if the vaccine is not effective against these variants?
sentences.zh: 所以我们的脑海深处一直在自我质问，如果疫苗对这些变异株无效怎么办？

sentences.en: So we spent quite a bit of this year worrying about that.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们今年相当长的一部分时间都在为此担忧。

sentences.en: What's in your mind as you're thinking about what lies ahead for Good Shepherd next year?
sentences.zh: 当你在思考明年“好牧人”将面临什么时，你脑子里在想什么？

sentences.en: Well, I've already told my staff, I'm 64 years old.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我已经告诉我的员工了，我64岁了。

sentences.en: I'll be retiring in two more years.
sentences.zh: 我再过两年就要退休了。

sentences.en: I told them that if this is still going on, that I'm not leaving.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他们，如果这种情况还在继续，我是不会离开的。

sentences.en: Because I feel, you know, a tremendous amount of responsibility to our residents, their family members, and certainly our staff.
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得，你知道的，我对我们的居民、他们的家属，当然还有我们的员工，有着巨大的责任感。

sentences.en: What would it say if, in the middle of this, I just got on my horse and rode off into the sunset?
sentences.zh: 如果在这个时候，我直接骑上马扬长而去，这算怎么回事？

sentences.en: Because my concern is, this is never going to end.
sentences.zh: 因为我担心，这永远不会结束。

sentences.en: We're going to be dealing with this in one form or another.
sentences.zh: 我们将以这样或那样的形式继续应对它。

sentences.en: I guess maybe the only thing I can compare it to is, like, being awake during a nightmare.
sentences.zh: 我想我能拿来作比较的唯一的可能就是，就像在噩梦中保持清醒一样。

sentences.en: There may be peaks and valleys.
There may be successes and failures.
But you never know what the next day is going to hold.
sentences.zh: 但你永远不知道明天会发生什么。

sentences.en: You never know when the next variant is going to come, how contagious and how deadly it's going to be.
sentences.zh: 你永远不知道下一个变异株什么时候会来，它会有多强的传染性和致死率。

sentences.en: And from my perspective, I don't see any end to this.
sentences.zh: 从我的角度来看，我看不到这有任何尽头。

sentences.en: The week after Don and I spoke, the Omicron variant was identified.
sentences.zh: 我和唐交谈的一周后，奥密克戎变异株被识别出来。

sentences.en: There was one more resident I had planned to speak with.
sentences.zh: 还有一位居民是我原本计划交谈的。

sentences.en: I wish I was, but I'm 96.
But a few days before we were supposed to talk, Good Shepherd reached out to let me know that she had passed away peacefully in her sleep.
sentences.zh: 但在我们本该交谈的几天前，“好牧人”联系我，告知她在睡梦中安详地去世了。

sentences.en: I like to have a good time.
Today's episode was produced by Stella Tan and Rachel Quester, with help from Alexandra Lee Young and Diana Nguyen.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由斯特拉·陈和雷切尔·奎斯特制作，亚历山大·李·杨和黛安娜·阮提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Anita Badajo, Lisa Chow, and Dave Shaw, engineered by Brad Fisher and Marian Lozano, and contains original music by Alisha Baitoop and Dan Powell.
sentences.zh: 节目由安妮塔·巴达霍、莉萨·周和戴夫·肖剪辑，布拉德·费舍尔和玛丽安·洛萨诺进行混音，并包含阿利莎·拜托普和丹·鲍威尔创作的原创音乐。
这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱、有时又令人热血沸腾的争斗中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》中，我和萨拉·凯尼格一起，讲述人们试图保持影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
